caseNameFull: W. E. Stewart v. E. G. McAllister
summary: Error to the Court of Civil Appeals, Fourth Supreme Judicial District, of the State of Texas.
attorneys: Mr. Don A. Bliss, with whom Mr. T. T. Vanderhoeven and Mr. Benjamin A. Greathouse were on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. J. G. George, for defendants in error, submitted.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction: (1) Act of September 6,1916, c. 448, 39 Stat. 726. (2) Goodrich v. Ferris, 214 U. S. 71, 79; Toop v. Ulysses Land Co., 237 U. S. 580, *560583; United Surety Co. v. American Fruit Co., 238 U. S. 140, 142; Sugarman v. United States, 249 U. S. 182, 184; Berkman v. United States, 250 U. S. 114, 118; Piedmont Power & Light Co. v. Graham, 253 U. S. 193.

Mr. Don A. Bliss, with whom Mr. T. T. Vanderhoeven and Mr. Benjamin A. Greathouse were on the brief, for plaintiff in error. Mr. J. G. George, for defendants in error, submitted.
